text:
greg_fin: Flag from partner NovaChain: their AWS Marketplace settlement shows 304k tokens billed as "inference_tokens" but our reseller ledger classified 304k as "api_calls" which maps to a lower rate. They say net shortfall ~ $9k. Can billing triage?

heidi_billing: pulling marketplace report + our import. do we have partner invoice id?

greg_fin: invoice NC-APR-2026-19. Partner pasted snippet: 
```
sku,usage_date,units,usage_type
redwood-inference.tokens,2026-04-12,304000,inference_tokens
```

lucas_partners: tagging in. NovaChain claims they set usage_type to inference_tokens in the portal CSV.

ingest-bot: deploy: billing-ingest v3.4.0 deployed 2026-04-12T02:30:10Z.

heidi_billing: raw marketplace file shows usage_type=inference_tokens. Our normalized import CSV shows usage_type=api_calls for those rows and unit_rate applied was $0.03/token vs $0.05/token.

greg_fin: delta per token $0.02 * 304,000 = $6,080. Partner also had 40 reserved instance-hours misattributed at $75/hr -> $3,000. Total ~$9,080.

lucas_partners: partner already put payout on hold until this is resolved. They asked for a corrected payable rather than a credit note.

heidi_billing: checking ingest logs. There is a normalization map in v3.4.0 that consolidates synonyms: "inference_tokens", "tokens", "token_usage" -> unified field. But looks like a regression: the map incorrectly maps "inference_tokens" -> "api_calls" due to a config merge error. Log shows "info: usage_type_map applied: inference_tokens -> api_calls".

greg_fin: so ingestion changed mapping and silently changed rates. That's on us.

heidi_billing: proposed remediation: (1) generate corrected reseller_payable CSV with original usage_type preserved for NovaChain and re-run import to regenerate invoice NC-APR-2026-19-rev1, (2) if payout already scheduled, treasury to top-up $9,080, (3) patch mapping config and add unit test + deploy guard to prevent usage_type remap regressions, (4) alert when applied-rate != expected-rate for a partner by > $100.

frank_treasury: pre-approve top-up of $9,080 pending confirmation from billing import. Create FIN ticket for audit trail.

lucas_partners: partner prefers corrected invoice. They also asked that we log the mapping change and share it in the partner portal so partners see historical mapping.

heidi_billing: running backfill now. ETA 10m. I'll attach corrected invoice draft to FIN-3725 when ready.

ingest-bot: backfill job started: backfill-id bf-2026-04-12-7811.

heidi_billing: backfill complete. s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/2026-04-novachain-recalc.csv import id imp-2026-04-12-7811. Corrected delta confirmed $9,080. Draft invoice NC-APR-2026-19-rev1 attached to FIN-3725.

frank_treasury: scheduling top-up payment and marking FIN-3725 approved for adjustment. Please include controller sign-off on GL entries before month-end close.

lucas_partners: messaged NovaChain: "We found an internal mapping regression that remapped your usage_type. We've regenerated your invoice (rev1) and scheduled a top-up of $9,080. No action required on your side." They acknowledged.

greg_fin: RCA for FIN-3725: billing-ingest v3.4.0 config merge introduced incorrect usage_type normalization mapping causing "inference_tokens" to be treated as "api_calls". Impact: NovaChain settlement underpaid by $9,080. Remediation: regenerated invoice and ledger, scheduled payment top-up, fixed mapping config, added unit tests and monitoring for usage_type->rate mismatches, published mapping change notes in partner portal.

frank_treasury: noted. Close FIN-3725 after payment posts and controller approves GL entries.

heidi_billing: leaving thread open until AP posts payment.
